# Procurement MCP

Procurement MCP is a Model Context Protocol server with 7 tools. `search_offers` searches up to 16 marketplaces at once and returns one ranked list. Each [Offer](reference/glossary.md#term-offer) carries a delivery status and a [Landed cost](reference/glossary.md#term-landed-cost) in AUD for the [Destination](reference/glossary.md#term-destination), which is Brisbane 4000 by default.

Every source is a hosted API that the server calls with a key. With no keys set, the `ozbargain` and `cheapies` deal feeds work. Every other [Marketplace](reference/glossary.md#term-marketplace) returns a [Diagnostic](reference/glossary.md#term-diagnostic) that names the variable to set.

**Run it**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/belikh/procurement
cd procurement
uv sync
uv run python server.py
```
